title: Maximum Area of a Piece of Cake After Horizontal and Vertical Cuts
goal: Find the greatest rectangle area after full horizontal and vertical cake cuts.
strategy: Cuts divide each axis independently. The greatest possible piece combines the largest horizontal interval with the largest vertical interval.
